items.title: The universal first order thickening of a formally unramified morphism is formally unramified over the target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a formally unramified morphism Z -> X of algebraic spaces, the universal first order thickening Z' is shown to be formally unramified over X by testing the defining lifting property directly. The proof cuts out the scheme-theoretic inverse images of Z under the two comparison maps, uses the first order thickening structure to identify the two-step situation, and applies the universal property of Z' twice to conclude that the two maps agree. The two applications of the universal property, licensed by the intersection identity, are the load-bearing steps. Retained author proof at lines 3192-3215.
